Start building, with Twenty Get started Talk to us Is Twenty really open-source? Yes. Twenty is the #1 Open Source CRM on GitHub. You can self-host to fully own your infrastructure, or run it on our managed cloud for a zero-ops setup. How long does it take to get started? Sign up for Cloud in under a minute and start your 30-day trial. For larger rollouts, our team can support you along the way. Reach out to discuss what you need. Can I migrate from Salesforce or HubSpot? Yes. Import your data via CSV, or use our API for 50,000+ records. Our partners can handle the full migration for you. Do I need a developer to customize Twenty? No. Build custom objects, fields, views, and no-code workflows straight from Settings. Unlimited, no extra charge. Can developers extend Twenty with code? Yes, with our Apps framework. Scaffold an extension with `npx twenty@latest app init my-app` and ship custom objects, server-side logic functions, React components that render inside Twenty’s UI, AI skills and agents, views, and navigation, all in TypeScript, deployable to any workspace. Does Twenty work with Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor? Yes. Every Cloud workspace ships with a native MCP server. Connect your AI assistant via OAuth and it can read and write your CRM data in natural language. What does Twenty cost? Cloud Pro is $9/user/month and Organization is $39/user/month, billed yearly.
